# PlanPlate: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-19 · code 08d8ffd252d3 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Run bookings for all your restaurants: opening hours, a drag-and-drop floor plan, automatic approvals, menus, specials, events and a booking form for your website.
**Live:** https://planplate-test.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/restres · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/planplate/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py restres` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **The host stand** (what staff keep open on a tablet) is `Pages/Reservations`: it polls `get_day_stamp` every minute
  and on `visibilitychange`, chimes (`PP.chime`) and holds a wake lock (`PP.wake`), both in `theme/assets/pp-kit.js`.
  One-tap Approve / Seat / Finish lives in `Items/ResRow` (`_act`) and `Items/Arrival` (Today); walk-ins in `Dialogs/WalkIn`
  -> `Portal.quick_walk_in`. The guide's section "The host stand" lists what came from the old PlanPlate apps.
- **Yes/no settings in their own column** (e.g. `restaurants.review_notes`): read with `Booking.flag(r, name)`, never
  `r[name]`, so the live app keeps working until the owner accepts the schema change.
- **Design:** no eyebrow labels, no side stripes, nothing under 12 px; deliberate exceptions carry `design-ok: <rule>`.
  The checks: `APP_MAKER/tools/design_check.py restres` and `tools/ui_test.py --only design.js`.
- **How-to guide** for users: `docs/howto/` (guide.json + sections/*.md + shots/), tool `tools/howto/howto.py` (stale / shoot <section> / build).
  In the app: `#howto` (Pages/HowTo, header tab) shows the GENERATED `client_code/howto_content.py`; RestaurantNav's How to link opens the tab's section.
  Update only the sections `stale` names; README there has the steps and the artifact URL.
- **Big parties** (Nov 19 2026): `Booking.seat_party` / `plan_for` / `apply_moves` push joinable tables together (and move one
  other booking if needed); online = pending, approving does the move. Tables page "Try a big party" = `Portal.test_party`.
- **Website elements** (`Pages/Elements`): all paste-able codes. Reserve button = `Public.embed_js` (style/shape/size/lang
  options). Gallery = `theme/assets/pp-showcase.js` + `/_/api/showcase/<slug>`; old `planplate-gallery.js` stays for old embeds.
- **Drag to reorder** = `PP.sortable` (pp-kit.js): website sections (`content.order`) and gallery photos.
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/session_test.py`: Expired-session test: the app must reload quietly (same page, still signed in, typed text kept) ins…
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
